What were total sales and orders in the:
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT MAX(FullDate) AS MaxDate FROM silver.dim_date
)
SELECT
    CAST(SUM(fs.TotalAmount) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Revenue,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fs.TransactionID)           AS OrderCount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fs.CustomerID)              AS ActiveCustomers,
    CAST(SUM(fs.TotalAmount) * 1.0
        / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT fs.TransactionID),0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS AOV
FROM silver.fact_sales fs
JOIN silver.dim_date  dd ON fs.DateID = dd.DateID
CROSS JOIN latest l
WHERE dd.FullDate >= DATEADD(DAY, -30, l.MaxDate);
Top 10 products by revenue with category:
SELECT TOP (10)
    dp.ProductName,
    dp.Category,
    CAST(SUM(fs.TotalAmount) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Revenue,
    SUM(fs.Quantity)                          AS UnitsSold
FROM silver.fact_sales fs
JOIN silver.dim_product dp ON fs.ProductID = dp.ProductID
GROUP BY dp.ProductName, dp.Category
ORDER BY Revenue DESC;
Monthly revenue trend with MoM growth:
WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT
        dd.Year, dd.Month,
        CAST(SUM(fs.TotalAmount) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Revenue
    FROM silver.fact_sales fs
    JOIN silver.dim_date dd ON fs.DateID = dd.DateID
    GROUP BY dd.Year, dd.Month
)
SELECT
    Year, Month, Revenue,
    LAG(Revenue) OVER (ORDER BY Year, Month) AS PrevRevenue,
    CAST( (Revenue - LAG(Revenue) OVER (ORDER BY Year, Month))
        * 100.0 / NULLIF(LAG(Revenue) OVER (ORDER BY Year, Month),0)
        AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS MoM_Pct
FROM monthly
ORDER BY Year, Month;
Revenue by region, with share of total:
WITH r AS (
    SELECT dc.Region,
           CAST(SUM(fs.TotalAmount) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Revenue
    FROM silver.fact_sales fs
    JOIN silver.dim_customer dc
        ON fs.CustomerID = dc.CustomerID AND dc.IsCurrent = 1
    GROUP BY dc.Region
)
SELECT Region, Revenue,
       CAST(Revenue * 100.0 / SUM(Revenue) OVER () AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS SharePct
FROM r
ORDER BY Revenue DESC;
Sentiment mix and average rating per pro:
SELECT
    dp.ProductName,
    dp.Category,
    SUM(CASE WHEN dr.Sentiment = 'Positive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Positive,
    SUM(CASE WHEN dr.Sentiment = 'Negative' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Negative,
    SUM(CASE WHEN dr.Sentiment = 'Neutral'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Neutral,
    SUM(CASE WHEN dr.Sentiment = 'Mixed'    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Mixed,
    CAST(AVG(CAST(dr.Rating AS DECIMAL(4,2))) AS DECIMAL(4,2)) AS AvgRating,
    COUNT(*) AS ReviewCount
FROM silver.dim_reviews dr
JOIN silver.dim_product dp ON dr.ProductID = dp.ProductID
WHERE dr.IsCurrent = 1
GROUP BY dp.ProductName, dp.Category
ORDER BY AvgRating DESC, ReviewCount DESC;
Which products have high revenue but low:
WITH rev AS (
    SELECT fs.ProductID,
           CAST(SUM(fs.TotalAmount) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Revenue
    FROM silver.fact_sales fs
    GROUP BY fs.ProductID
),
rat AS (
    SELECT ProductID,
           CAST(AVG(CAST(Rating AS DECIMAL(4,2))) AS DECIMAL(4,2)) AS AvgRating,
           COUNT(*) AS Reviews
    FROM silver.dim_reviews
    WHERE IsCurrent = 1
    GROUP BY ProductID
)
SELECT TOP (10)
    dp.ProductName, dp.Category,
    rev.Revenue, rat.AvgRating, rat.Reviews
FROM rev
JOIN rat ON rev.ProductID = rat.ProductID
JOIN silver.dim_product dp ON dp.ProductID = rev.ProductID
WHERE rat.AvgRating < 3.0
ORDER BY rev.Revenue DESC;
Top 5 customers by lifetime spend, with:
WITH spend AS (
    SELECT fs.CustomerID,
           CAST(SUM(fs.TotalAmount) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS LifetimeSpend,
           COUNT(DISTINCT fs.TransactionID) AS Orders
    FROM silver.fact_sales fs
    GROUP BY fs.CustomerID
),
fav AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Category,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY SUM(TotalAmount) DESC) AS rn
    FROM silver.fact_sales fs
    JOIN silver.dim_product dp ON fs.ProductID = dp.ProductID
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Category
)
SELECT TOP (5)
    dc.FirstName + ' ' + dc.LastName AS CustomerName,
    dc.Region, s.LifetimeSpend, s.Orders, f.Category AS FavoriteCategory
FROM spend s
JOIN silver.dim_customer dc
    ON s.CustomerID = dc.CustomerID AND dc.IsCurrent = 1
JOIN fav f ON f.CustomerID = s.CustomerID AND f.rn = 1
ORDER BY s.LifetimeSpend DESC;
Quarterly sales by category (pivot-style:
SELECT
    dp.Category, dd.Year, dd.Quarter,
    CAST(SUM(fs.TotalAmount) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Revenue
FROM silver.fact_sales fs
JOIN silver.dim_product dp ON fs.ProductID = dp.ProductID
JOIN silver.dim_date    dd ON fs.DateID    = dd.DateID
GROUP BY dp.Category, dd.Year, dd.Quarter
ORDER BY dd.Year, dd.Quarter, Revenue DESC;
